propositions: Canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden compatibility alias `rebar bridge-status` must use identical parser, core, options, output formats, errors, and exit codes.

Durable status is recorded by a single process-finalizer writer to `refs/reconciler/last-pass` before lock release using three-attempt CAS with 100ms and 200ms backoff; exhausted contention or persistent failure must emit clear error and return nonzero without claiming durability.
Status verdicts follow total precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with NEVER_RUN when no record and no live lock; all verdicts except PAUSED and HEALTHY must exit nonzero.

Canary moves from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable git state by fetching `+refs/reconciler/*:refs/reconciler/*`, performing two read-only snapshots for live-lock detection, and defaulting to status source while retaining explicit github-api rollback for one release.

Writer and status derive stable local identity from explicit REBAR_ENV_ID or checkout `.env-id`; missing, empty, or unreadable `.env-id` is a hard configuration error for writer/status, while inbound event metadata and LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID remain unchanged.

Status is read-only and never mutates, calls steal(), or sleeps for lease; canary waits the observed lease_secs from lock blob (default 120, reject if over 480 seconds) and uses stalled fence to detect CRASHED state.
